aggregate_scaler.description: Mean/std over unique valid TRAIN-split per-minute aggregate readings from five_homes_modeling.parquet (NOT reconstructed window contents -- avoids non-uniform duplication bias near segment edges/gaps). Pooled across the four development households only -- household 8386 (held-out unseen test household) is absent from the train split by construction and contributes nothing to this fit.
aggregate_scaler.units_note: Original, unconverted dataset measurement units. Physical unit (kW vs W) not independently verified.

target_scaler_description: Per-appliance mean/std over valid TRAIN-split window-endpoint targets (window_labels_train.parquet) -- matches the population actually used by the regression loss. Same four-development-household, train-only population as the aggregate scaler above.
